H2.denominator: mode rows evaluable for both Oracle and NLA

probe_method: unchanged W1 lambda0.001, 5 template-grouped folds on test, train-only standardization; fixed OOF bootstrap

surprisal_policy.cluster: Original frozen W1 template-family cluster and dev/test assignments retained.
surprisal_policy.donors: Hash draw from same domain/row and original cluster in the full frozen pool, regardless of surprisal; middle-tercile donors remain eligible.
surprisal_policy.length: Report actual selected-row KS p and mean difference after label derivation; if mismatch, mark LENGTH_CONFOUNDED, descriptive only, no retrospective rematching.
surprisal_policy.mode_active_gate: Not applicable to raw W1 surprisal text (no operating instruction); probe and random-donor gates apply. Report separately from 14 mode rows and H1/H2.
surprisal_policy.pool: All prose/Python binary W1 items, byte-identical raw prefixes; W1 ordinal sub-rows excluded.
surprisal_policy.quantity: -log_softmax(base-model logits at position read_position - 1)[input_ids[read_position]]; natural-log nats, NOT next-token entropy
surprisal_policy.scoring: Score all pool items true and random-donor before deriving labels. No recapture or score-dependent selection.
surprisal_policy.terciles: Within domain and original dev/test split, ascending (surprisal, opaque id); bottom floor(n/3) = low, top floor(n/3) = high; middle unused. Stable ID breaks ties. No sign flip.
